_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/client-modules.md / claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛'). Paths below are relative to client/src/ (the --root passed to the shared scripts/checkFileLength.mjs), so e.g. "net/ApiClient.ts" means client/src/net/ApiClient.ts. checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, a listed file grows past the line count recorded here, or (2026-08-13, G3) an entry has no 'reason' or its 'lines' exceeds the 800-line hard cap. Schema: { "path": { "lines": <number>, "reason": "<why this is a justified exception>" } }. Splitting a file below 500 lines does not require touching this file (reported as a housekeeping notice instead of failing) but delete its entry and move the note into claudedocs/client-modules.md's 已完成 list. Do not bump 'lines' to silence a GREW violation without updating 'reason' to actually explain the growth. 2026-08-13 audit found 11 of the 19 entries below had accumulated with no written justification at all (some for 2+ days) — the schema change here exists specifically to make that impossible going forward; see claudedocs/client-modules.md's CI-gate-refactor note for the full audit.

game/meta/SaveManager.ts.reason: Cloud-sync orchestrator that also owns the local save mirror. 641->696 on 2026-09-09 (751bd0e74) adding a third offline queue (pendingFlags, the launch-gate flag-write retry), then 696->532 the same day by extracting SaveManager/offlineQueues.ts (form(1)): all three offline settlement queues (pending clears / pendingStamina / pendingFlags) and the PvE actions that fill them (spendStaminaForLevel / recordClear / the replay re-verification they trigger) moved there, leaving only two one-line forwards here for the entry points scenes and nav already call by name. This entry was deliberately NOT renewed on its previous justification, which claimed the 'single shared-state+business-logic root' shape 'same as CityScene/core.ts's historical exception' -- that CityScene exception was itself revoked on 2026-08-13 once its '5 async network actions + 5 pure helpers' turned out to have plenty of extraction precedent, so the same verdict applies here: the seam that reason denied did exist, and it has been taken. What remains is state ownership rather than extractable logic -- the `save`/`reconciledAccountId` fields, the subscriber set, persist()/reconcile()/adoptServer() (the only writers of those fields), the optimistic flag/equip round trips, and the bootstrap/refresh/adoptSession/resetForLogout orchestration that drives the flushers. Pulling reconcile() out next would hand a free function write access to save/reconciledAccountId/notifiedSyncGaps from outside the class, which is worse encapsulation than the ~30 lines it would save -- same call already made for EquipmentScene/core.ts (525) and CardScene/core.ts (519).

net/ApiClient.ts.reason: Thin one-line-per-endpoint forwarding facade over a composition split (2026-08-11). Every line exists because dozens of call sites across the codebase already call `apiClient.methodName(...)` directly; no shared/tangled state to separate, splitting the facade further would just fragment the forward list. 555→559 on 2026-09-04 adding iapAppleSync, one one-line forward plus its blank line, for the iOS auto-renewable-subscription receipt-sync route. 559→563 on 2026-09-07 adding setAppleConsumptionConsent, one one-line forward plus its blank line, for the StoreKit 2 batch's consumption-data consent endpoint (ADR-082).

net/WorldApiClient.ts.reason: Same thin-forwarding-facade shape as ApiClient.ts above (shrunk 712→534 by the 2026-08-11 composition conversion; 534→542 on 2026-08-14 adding setFamilyEmblem/setSectEmblem, two more one-line forwards for the new emblem-picker endpoints; 542→544 on 2026-08-19 re-exporting the WorldCityNodeView type for the published-city-node rendering fix; 544→546 on 2026-08-25 adding getCities, one one-line forward + its doc comment for the ADR-074 P1 wild-city siege-state refresh; 546→553 on 2026-08-27 adding getMyBids, one one-line forward + its doc comment plus the AuctionBidView type in both re-export lists, for the server-backed My-Bids tab) — dozens of call sites already call `worldApi.methodName(...)` directly, so splitting the facade further would only fragment the forward list.
